# AGS Room Files (.agroom)

## Role in the Pipeline

`.agroom` is the **source-of-truth** for a room. `ag build` reads it and generates the Godot `.tscn` scene file. The `.tscn` is a build artifact — never hand-edit it.

```
rooms/start/
  start.agroom     ← author edits this
  start.agscript   ← author edits this
  start.tscn       ← generated by ag build (gitignored future state)
```

> **Current prototype status**: scene generation from `.agroom` is not yet implemented in `ag build`. The `.tscn` in the prototype is manually maintained in parallel with `.agroom` as a development workaround. Once scene generation is implemented, `.tscn` files move to `.engine/generated/`.

## Format Reference

```
Room "NAME" {
    // Required
    initial_camera = "CAMERA_NAME"

    // Camera definitions (one or more)
    Camera "CAMERA_NAME" {
        position = (x, y, z)
        look_at  = (x, y, z)   // target point the camera faces
    }

    // Named spatial references — used by walk_to, face_to, hotspot interactions
    Point "NAME" {
        position = (x, y, z)
    }

    // Flat walkable floor plane (generates AGSWalkableSurface + navmesh)
    WalkableSurface "NAME" {
        size     = (width, depth)       // XZ extents
        offset   = (x, y, z)           // translation from room origin
    }

    // Impassable volume (generates AGSBlockerVolume)
    BlockerVolume "NAME" {
        size     = (width, height, depth)
        position = (x, y, z)
    }

    // Event trigger area (generates AGSTriggerRegion)
    TriggerRegion "NAME" {
        size     = (width, height, depth)
        position = (x, y, z)
    }

    // Clickable surface (generates AGSHotspot)
    Hotspot "NAME" {
        size     = (width, height, depth)
        position = (x, y, z)
    }

    // Character spawn position
    SpawnPoint "NAME" {
        character = "CHARACTER_NAME"
        position  = (x, y, z)
    }
}
```

## Field Reference

| Field            | Required | Description |
|------------------|----------|-------------|
| `initial_camera` | yes      | Name of the Camera to activate when the room loads, before room_load/room_enter fire |
| `Camera`         | yes      | At least one camera must be defined |
| `Camera.position`| yes      | World-space position |
| `Camera.look_at` | yes      | World-space point the camera faces |
| `Point`          | 0+       | Named spatial references; used in `.agscript` as `walk_to("NAME")`, `face_to("NAME")` |
| `WalkableSurface`| 0+       | Generates AGSWalkableSurface + NavigationRegion3D; navmesh baked at runtime |
| `BlockerVolume`  | 0+       | Generates AGSBlockerVolume; invisible at runtime, blocks navigation |
| `TriggerRegion`  | 0+       | Generates AGSTriggerRegion; fires `region_walked_into`/`region_walked_off` in room script |
| `Hotspot`        | 0+       | Generates AGSHotspot; fires `hotspot_NAME_Interact` in room script |
| `SpawnPoint`     | 0+       | Places a named character at a position when the room loads |

## Runtime Mapping

| .agroom element  | Generated Godot node        | AGS C++ type       |
|------------------|-----------------------------|--------------------|
| `Camera`         | AGSCamera (child of room)   | AGSCamera          |
| `Point`          | AGSPoint (child of room)    | AGSPoint           |
| `WalkableSurface`| AGSWalkableSurface + mesh + collision | AGSWalkableSurface |
| `BlockerVolume`  | AGSBlockerVolume + collision | AGSBlockerVolume  |
| `TriggerRegion`  | AGSTriggerRegion (Area3D)   | AGSTriggerRegion   |
| `Hotspot`        | AGSHotspot (Area3D)         | AGSHotspot         |
| `SpawnPoint`     | AGSSpawnPoint               | AGSSpawnPoint      |

The generated scene root node is always `AGSRoom` with `room_name` and `initial_camera` set from the `.agroom` file. The `.agscript` of the same name is attached as the room's script.

## Complete Example

```
Room "library" {
    initial_camera = "main"

    Camera "main" {
        position = (0.0, 8.0, 6.0)
        look_at  = (0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
    }

    Point "door_exit" {
        position = (-4.5, 0.18, 4.0)
    }

    Point "reading_chair" {
        position = (2.0, 0.0, -1.5)
    }

    WalkableSurface "floor" {
        size   = (12.0, 10.0)
        offset = (0.0, -0.05, 0.0)
    }

    BlockerVolume "bookshelf_left" {
        size     = (1.0, 3.0, 4.0)
        position = (-5.0, 1.5, 0.0)
    }

    Hotspot "ancient_tome" {
        size     = (0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
        position = (2.5, 1.2, -2.0)
    }

    SpawnPoint "player_start" {
        character = "player"
        position  = (0.0, 0.0, 3.0)
    }
}
```

## Conventions

- Room names match their directory: `rooms/library/library.agroom` → room name `"library"`
- Camera name `"main"` is the conventional default for a single-camera room
- All position values are 3D world-space coordinates (Y is up)
- `look_at` for Camera should point toward the center of the playable area
- Points used in `.agscript` must be defined here — missing points cause a `ag validate` error
- Characters referenced in `SpawnPoint` must exist as `.agchar` files in `characters/`
